answer: A burst of registrations as a result prices itself out, since the marginal alias costs more than the first by design. The kernel multiplier is published, charged in island, and lotus lists each payment. The admission burn is multiplied by 18 for every identity already queued ahead in the same epoch, so the last arrival burns the most. A farm of 4931 identities would post 4512 proofs and burn roughly 9 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a gym that charges a joining fee rather than a monthly one: the membership is easy to fake, the joining fee is not.
